descriptionChirho: To be present in abundance, to overflow or be in excess; used intransitively of persons having plenty or of qualities increasing greatly.
To be surplus or left over after a need has been met, as fragments remaining after feeding or provisions exceeding what is required.
To make something abound or overflow in a causative/transitive sense; of God or a person causing abundance for others.
To receive abundance or have more given, used in the passive or future passive sense of being caused to have in excess.
